title: "Projects"
---

My public GitHub repositories. This list updates automatically each time someone visits the page.

::: {#repos}
Loading…
:::

```{=html}
<script>
(async () => {
  const box = document.getElementById("repos");
  try {
    const res = await fetch("https://api.github.com/users/nigelk-dev/repos?sort=updated&per_page=100");
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(res.status);
    const repos = (await res.json()).filter(r => !r.fork);
    if (!repos.length) { box.textContent = "No public repositories yet."; return; }
    box.innerHTML = "";
    for (const r of repos) {
      const card = document.createElement("div");
      card.className = "repo-card";
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = r.html_url; a.textContent = r.name;
      const strong = document.createElement("strong"); strong.appendChild(a);
      card.appendChild(strong);
      if (r.description) {
        const p = document.createElement("p"); p.textContent = r.description; card.appendChild(p);
      }
      const meta = document.createElement("p"); meta.className = "repo-meta";
      meta.textContent = [r.language, "★ " + r.stargazers_count,
        "updated " + new Date(r.pushed_at).toLocaleDateString()].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
      card.appendChild(meta);
      box.appendChild(card);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    box.innerHTML = 'Couldn\'t load projects right now. See them on <a href="https://github.com/nigelk-dev">GitHub</a>.';
  }
})();
</script>
```
